rv.q: It is the smallest of blips in an otherwise magnificent production.
Gatiss and the ensemble have done a smart job of bringing it to life.
In all it’s a bold spectacle but I’m still dubious about what it can say to us today, apart from the obvious.

cn.t: Mark Gatiss terrifies in this timely RSC production of Brecht's Hitler parable, with critics praising its circus-like staging and contemporary resonance, though reception ranges from enthusiastic to more reserved.
